screen.pocketdimension.tutorial_page1_li: 1. Craft and place the Dimensional Table to get started.
2. Sneak and right-click the table with an empty hand to create a Dimensional Key.
3. Right-click with the key to enter or leave your pocket.
The area is generated as a limited island; outside it is void and the border rescues you.
Right-click the table normally to view and use its private recipes.
screen.pocketdimension.tutorial_page2_li: Place a Stabilizer Machine and link it by right-clicking with your key.
The machine consumes energy every 10 seconds; use batteries or other dimensional fuels.
You can insert fuel into the technical slot or feed the machine with a hopper.
The Quantum Air Generator improves the air using nearby trees, leaves and water.
Use the machine upgrades for size, security and energy capacity.
screen.pocketdimension.tutorial_page3_li: Normal right-click with the key: direct teleport with an energy cost.
Shift + right-click: open a temporary 2x3 rift; enter it to travel.
The rift lasts for a short time and closes automatically; leave free space in front of you.
Sneak near a player with the Hacker Key to set a target; use it again to attempt an intrusion.
Owners with OP are protected from the Hacker Key.
screen.pocketdimension.tutorial_page4_li: Keep stability high: when energy reaches zero, the dark collapse begins.
Poor atmosphere causes negative effects; keep plants, water and an air generator nearby.
If you leave the border, the pocket damages you and automatically returns you to the center.
Use /pocketdim info, /pocketdim home and /pocketdim return to check and travel.
In Settings you can change language, dimensional fog, details, help and edit the map. In editor mode, open the Shop to buy materials with energy.
book.pocketdimension.dimensional_guide.l: This manual explains how to create, power and protect your pocket dimension.
book.pocketdimension.category.getting_st: Build your first pocket and keep it stable.
book.pocketdimension.entry.first_steps.p: The Dimensional Table is the starting point for every pocket. Craft it, place it and use it to create your personal key.
Sneak and right-click the table with an empty hand to create a key. Right-click normally to open the private crafting interface.
Use the Dimensional Key to enter or leave your pocket. Sneak + right-click opens a temporary rift for travel. The key is bound to its owner.
book.pocketdimension.entry.stability.pag: Link a Stabilizer Machine with your key. Feed it dimensional fuel and it will maintain the energy that keeps your pocket stable.
The Void Stabilizer is a rare component used to build the Stabilizer Machine.
With Curios installed, equip the Void Stabilizer as a charm. It restores a small amount of pocket energy every 10 seconds while you are inside your linked pocket.
book.pocketdimension.entry.upgrades.name: Upgrades
book.pocketdimension.entry.upgrades.page: Use the Stabilizer Machine to apply Size, Security and Energy upgrades. Each upgrade improves a different part of your pocket.
The Quantum Air Generator improves the atmosphere when plants, leaves and water are nearby. Keep your island alive to make exploration safer.
